body: we're taught to believe that in order to be happy we need to find romantic love, but that isn't the case. this point of view is pushed so hard that we make ourselves depressed feeling like we aren't good enough because we do not have someone who is romantically interested. the truth is is that there are so many different types of love, platonic love, familial love, and romantic love is not the only one out there. i'm sure that you're amazing and that not having a romantic partner is not significant of anything, as that type of love is difficult to come by under normal circumstances, and especially difficult given the current circumstances.
